name: ParametricNoise distribution remap, quantize and rank sort
plain: Three operators that change the value distribution or the arrangement of the noise without new randomness. DistributionRemap pushes each value through the normal CDF and a target inverse CDF (uniform, Laplace, Cauchy, logistic, Student-t), clamping the tails for the heavy-tailed ones and rescaling to the input's std. Quantize snaps values to N levels by value or rank, to ±1 binary, to sparse ±1/√density impulses at the largest |x|, or to levels with row-wise error diffusion. RankSort keeps the exact multiset of values but reorders them by a row, column, spiral, radial or diagonal key, optionally in blocks, which biases composition while the histogram stays Gaussian.
math:
Symbols: Φ normal CDF; Q target inverse CDF; x noise.
Remap: y = Q(clamp(Φ(x))) · std(x)/std(y); out = (1−s)x + s·y.
Levels(value): lo + round((x−lo)/(hi−lo)·(L−1))/(L−1)·(hi−lo). Impulse: keep top k=round(density·n) by |x| at sign(x)·√(n/k), else 0.
RankSort: sort values within each block, write them to positions ordered by the layout key; out=(1−s)x + s·sorted.

props.params: Remap distribution laplace default, df 3, strength 1, tail_clamp 0.999; Quantize mode levels|binary|impulse|dither, levels 8, by value|rank, density 0.05, normalize on; RankSort axis row|column|spiral|radial|diagonal, block_size 0, strength 1
